# Trip Trek India

> Trip Trek India is a Delhi-based travel company that runs Himalayan treks, weekend getaways, pilgrimage circuits and group trips across Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan and Jammu & Kashmir. Trips include transport, stay on a sharing basis, listed meals and an experienced Trip Captain. Seats are booked online with a ₹2,000 per person advance.

Founded by Rajnish Yadav (founder) and Aman Singh (co-founder). Website: https://triptrekindia.in. Instagram: @trip.trekindia. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 93109 65771, +91 88105 55416. Email: info@triptrekindia.in (bookings: Bookings@triptrekindia.in).
